name: friction-diagnostics
description: Friction diagnostics for agents: log genuine surprises — moments when reality diverged from what you predicted, in any domain (code, writing, research, ops) — as structured JSONL with recurrence tracking, then batch-mend the accumulated corpus on request: cluster open events, root-cause them, fix the sources that misled, and distill known traps that the plugin's session-start hook surfaces whenever the store has open events. Predicted or engineered outcomes (intended test failures, expected error paths, probes) are not friction.
